title: The McDonald's Field
content: When I was a kid I had a dream I was at my local McDonald's playground (The playground used to have this type of rug that resembles grass) and I was in the tunnel thing, I looked outside and the bubble and this is how it looked like. I gives me goosebumps cause it's the closest thing I have seen to my dream that I will never forget it. Has anyone ever dreamed of something similar?
